function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Produce a comprehensive, source-grounded evidence dossier for answering this question as of October 1, 2026: How can one reconstruct, using only evidence returned by benchmark tools and citing exclusively the source IDs those tools provide, the publicly documented OneCoin/Cryptoqueen fraud scheme? Cover origins and chronology; operating model and whether the cryptocurrency/blockchain claims were genuine or deceptive; promotion, education packages, multilevel recruitment structure, and geographic reach; movement of funds or proceeds only where specifically supported; principal founders and other central participants, preserving the exact tool-supported entity IDs and relationship names and documenting each person's role; and the status of Ruja Ignatova, clearly separating established enforcement facts from allegations, investigative assessments, media reports, and unresolved claims (including whether she is missing, presumed dead, alive, or unconfirmed). Use only evidence returned by the benchmark/research tools, do not infer unsupported details, and retain every exact source ID, entity ID, and relation name needed for a final report. Explicitly flag contradictions, source type, evidentiary status, dates, and uncertainty. The final answer will need to be a complete readable Markdown report ending with a fenced JSON object whose only top-level arrays are exactly findings, claims, reasoning_steps, and contradictions; every finding must have question, answer, supporting_entities, and source_references; every claim must have claim and source_references; every reasoning step must have id, conclusion, premise_entities, and premise_relations; every contradiction must have contradiction_id, description, and source_references."}
function.name: ConductResearch
